           <lg>    <l>gzhan <choice><reg/><orig>{°}</orig></choice>ma pham chos rgyal dri myed pa sa <choice><reg>stengs</reg><orig>steng‹s›</orig></choice> 'dir ||</l> <l>byang chub shing dbang drung du mngon sangs rgyas pa na <choice><reg>||</reg><orig>‹¦›</orig></choice></l><l><rs type="person" ref="db:3831" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">chos kyi seng ge</rs> blo gsal grags pa'i nyi 'od kyis ||</l> <l><lb n="93a4"/> theg pa mchog la rmongs pa'i rab rib sel gyur cig ||</l></lg>
         <note type="translation">When the Unconquered by others (i.e. Maitreya as a future buddha), the King of Doctrine, the Stainless one, will have correctly awaken under the bodhi-tree king (in Bodhgayā), on the earth,
May the eye-disease (timira) of ignorance with regard to the excellent vehicle be dispelled by the glorious sun-rays of the clear-minded one, the Lion of the doctrine (Chos kyi seng ge).</note></seg></TEI>
